statement: For a finite random-cluster graph with q>0, fixed boundary partition xi, and two fixed classes u,v, merging those classes changes the partition-function ratio to Z_fused/Z_xi=q^(-1)+(1-q^(-1))*P_xi(u connected to v). The same formula holds after restricting both partition sums to any positive-probability predictable exploration history.
assumptions: same strictly interior edge probabilities under both measures
exactly two fixed boundary classes fused
proof_or_counterexample: On A the fusion preserves the cluster count; off A it lowers it by one. Divide the two full or history-restricted partition sums. Conditional expectation of the fixed event A gives the history formula without multiplying conditional probabilities.
remaining_gap: No asymptotic connectivity profile, conformal covariance, slit-domain convergence, or SLE identification follows.

statement: Let W be a continuous adapted chordal Loewner driver and 0<x1<x2<y remain unswallowed. With U_i=(g_t(x_i)-W_t)/(g_t(y)-W_t) and H'_kappa(u)=u^(-4/kappa)(1-u)^(8/kappa-2), if H_kappa(U_1) and H_kappa(U_2) are continuous local martingales in one usual filtration, then W is a continuous local martingale with quadratic variation kappa dt up to their common swallowing time.
assumptions: common filtration and localized unswallowed interval
both profile processes continuous local martingales
proof_or_counterexample: Invert H locally to make U1 a semimartingale and solve W=(g(x1)-U1*g(y))/(1-U1). Ito gives Y dA+(2/kappa)(1+1/U_i)(dV-kappa dt)=0 for i=1,2. Since 1/U1 differs from 1/U2, subtraction yields dV=kappa dt and then dA=0.
independent_reviewer: w593; Ito calculation independently rederived on 2026-10-10
remaining_gap: No FK construction is shown to make both H profiles local martingales in the scaling limit; q=4 H is unbounded at one endpoint. This lemma alone does not solve C0049.
